basis: Actual received responses, product envelopes, and adoption evidence; semantic judgments are distinct from protocol checks. No regeneration.

observations: Initial actual question asks list/search/category presentation rather than shopping versus first-to-eat purpose.
Free-text A/B answers were sent against that actual question; options were not fabricated or relabelled.
A/B scope and checks actually differ. Neither branch assumes available expiry dates; expiry is excluded or left open.
A chooses a line-list and a phone without an explicit selection of those details. B offers visually choosing from a plain name screen and leaves the first-to-eat criterion unresolved.
Original one-user/one-device/manual-input/order-delivery exclusions remain in Project decisions through adoption.
C1.interpretation: The explicit difference and no-expiry-assumption criteria are met; usefulness for finding the first ingredient to eat remains weak/uncertain. Presentation-first questioning and unselected phone/list choices prevent an unconditional semantic PASS.

C2.judgment: FAIL: unnecessary question + response contract violation; manual-edit branch NOT_EXECUTED
observations: Provider HTTP200 and finish stop; product HTTP502 INVALID_RESPONSE.
Raw JSON is parseable, but question.kind is fact with two options. Exact validator requires fact.options.length === 0.
Question asks output format despite the sufficient preview-only CLI requirements.
No accepted proposal exists, so dotfile manual edit/adoption and preservation in an accepted draft were not exercised. No synthetic replacement or repeat call.
C2.interpretation: Provider transport/auth succeeded. The failure belongs to model response structure and question choice; it is not a connection failure.

C3.judgment: PARTIAL: unknown branch useful; deferral overly conservative; latest checks flawed
observations: Unknown: ID-group frequencies and row/column overview, no source changes or deduplication.
Deferred: only row/column overview; scope explicitly excludes duplicate judgment. No destructive policy is invented, but policy-independent duplicate overview is not proposed.
Latest: selects one latest response per ID into a separate output and preserves source; time ties/format remain open.
Latest checks literally say the sum of excluded rows should match original rows, rather than retained plus excluded. They do not explicitly check that the retained timestamp is maximal.
C3.interpretation: Policy-dependent branch changes occur and no original deletion/final aggregate policy is silently imposed. Deferral loses a safe useful step, and latest completion conditions are not sufficiently correct.

C4.judgment: FAIL overall; A core constraints PASS, B explicit-change handling FAIL
observations: Initial question asks deliverable form, not the important offline-versus-limited-network conflict.
A remains offline/file-based/design-only and prohibits actual transmission/deployment.
B actually sends the explicit user amendment allowing only a notice-delivery network, together with unchanged earlier confirmed network ban.
B proposal.goal still says no network/file import only; scope prohibits network use.

Candidate proposalText appends the exact actual question and B answer, but the adopted draft contains both the contradictory proposal and the allowance. Text preservation is successful; semantic consistency is not.
C4.interpretation: An undeclared idea must not override confirmed decisions, but B is an explicit latest user amendment. The response does not distinguish them. No actual network/deployment operation was carried out.

productAdoption.limit: These cases are short. The 12000-character rejection and native UI preservation boundaries were not re-exercised here. No whole handoff/submit/continuity AI follow-up was generated.

nextMinimumChangesProposedOnly: Clarify the existing fact-versus-choice output contract; retain validator rejection and original failure evidence. Do not normalize invalid replies into successes.
Prioritize consequential policy/permission conflicts over presentation preferences, and let sufficient small tasks proceed without a cosmetic question.
Distinguish an explicit current answer amending a past decision from a speculative area idea, for the proposed draft only; do not auto-edit stored bases.
Keep policy-independent observation useful under unknown/deferred choices; make completion checks logically valid (retained + excluded = input, selected timestamp maximal).
After a separately reviewed minimal fix, rerun only the relevant original fixtures. Dotfile editing remains unverified until a valid CLI proposal is obtained.
limits: Synthetic actual-model experiment, four cases and one sample per request slot. No human efficacy claim, general failure-rate estimate, full-quality guarantee, prompt tuning, or product changes.
